---
title: "5. Run the analysis: Human stool study"
---

## Stage 1: exploration

From the main project folder:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/run_workflow.R data/zackular results/zackular config/zackular.tsv
```

Confirm `exploration-status.txt` says `COMPLETE`. Open all nine figures and
match each to its table using [the output map](../../01-run-the-workflow.qmd).
Shannon uses all features; grey Other affects composition display only.

PCoA uses Bray–Curtis on proportions with a Lingoes correction. The depth
sensitivity uses 20 equal-depth random subsamples and mean distances. These
are different distance definitions, not interchangeable results.

## Stage 2: inference

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/run_inference.R data/zackular results/zackular config/zackular.tsv
```

The script requires unchanged inputs/settings and a complete exploration.
It runs marginal PERMANOVA and dispersion checks for both distance definitions.
Read the group term's R-squared and p-value alongside dispersion and sample
structure. These tests do not turn an observational comparison into causation.

ANCOM-BC2 then models unrarefied counts with `age + sex + collection_location
+ group`, after 10% prevalence filtering. Positive natural-log group effects
mean higher estimated abundance in Carcinoma versus Healthy. BH-adjusted
p < 0.05 and pseudo-count sensitivity jointly define highlighted discoveries.
Structural-zero calling is disabled; unavailable results are not discoveries.

Open `da-volcano.png` and `da-effects.png` only after `inference-status.txt`
says `COMPLETE`. Up to 20 features appear in the effect plot even if none is
significant. These intervals are pointwise, not multiple-testing-adjusted.

If any command fails, stop. An incomplete folder can contain files from an earlier run. Preserve the error; do not write conclusions from partial results.
